name: discord_create_thread
description: POSTS IN PUBLIC: start a thread hanging off an existing message. Returns the thread channel, whose `id` is a channel id — one a human must allow before the bot can write in it.

channel_id.description: Discord channel id, e.g. '1180000000000000000'. Right-click the channel -> Copy Channel ID (Developer Mode on), or use discord_list_channels.

message_id.description: Message id, from the `id` of a message discord_send_message or discord_get_messages returned.

auto_archive_duration.description: Minutes of silence before it archives: 60, 1440, 4320 or 10080.
